notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Menus now have a slight navigation delay when first entering them (only navigation, not usage)
[*] The death screen's navigation delay is slightly longer so you don't accidentally interact with the main menu button
[/list]

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed upscaling shader for the game objects.
[*] Made the death screen a bit faster
[*] Made retrying a bit faster
[*] Added a loading indicator when retrying
[/list]

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Tweaked level 33 and 54
[*] Fixed pixel resolution on camera being two pixels too small
[*] Made the infinite mode flipped chance a lower percentage (80% -> 50%)
[/list]

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixes an issue when the system time format was set to the Japanese format, and it caused the game to enter an infinite loop... for some reason.
[/list]

notes.title: Project Ictos Version 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] A short delay when dying so you don't accidentally select the main menu option
[*] Levels are sorted in difficulty groups and randomly picked from those groups for Normal and Flipped Mode
[*] Properly reset level stats for the Discord Integration
[/list]

notes.title: Project Ictos has released!
notes.notes:
Project Ictos is now available to play after months of hard work!

Play through various game modes, such as Normal Mode, Flipped Mode and Infinite Mode. All of which have their own difficulties to conquer.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/3d0f6ad5199dc25cd8f6d722f49d394e618f53b3.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/3d0f6ad5199dc25cd8f6d722f49d394e618f53b3.gif[/img][/url]

If you can't quite beat some levels, hop into Practice Mode to refine your skills.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/e06562d6c65dd0eb5a251c8442f6855943809c78.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/e06562d6c65dd0eb5a251c8442f6855943809c78.gif[/img][/url]

I hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Game Releases Soon!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/06953859bbaba77170ff1843706f299cabf637df.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/06953859bbaba77170ff1843706f299cabf637df.gif[/img][/url]

Hello!

In just a few days Project Ictos will be releasing on Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck on February 23rd.

Play through various game modes, such as Normal Mode, Flipped Mode and Infinite Mode. All of which have their own difficulties to conquer.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/3d0f6ad5199dc25cd8f6d722f49d394e618f53b3.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/3d0f6ad5199dc25cd8f6d722f49d394e618f53b3.gif[/img][/url]

If you can't quite beat some levels, hop into Practice Mode to refine your skills.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/e06562d6c65dd0eb5a251c8442f6855943809c78.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823696/e06562d6c65dd0eb5a251c8442f6855943809c78.gif[/img][/url]

Jam out to the soundtrack by [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/7FvspmKAf0OXZbxx2A15hW?si=b-ALzKgcR_2JRcTstFSWkQ&nd=1&dlsi=2d76236c99b14a75]Skill Syrup[/url] while outlasting the dangerous environments.

Good luck, you'll need it!
